domain: advanced billing engine (tiered pricing, stacked discounts, regional tax, reverse-charge, precedence-heavy)
provenance: original, self-contained; no CoreLink or other-project artifacts
difficulty_notes: precedence/interaction traps: discount-before-rounding, sum-of-rounded-lines (!=round-of-sum), exact discount stacking order, tax-on-discounted, B2B reverse-charge exempt from the minimum floor, inclusive tier boundaries, strict int-only quantity (bool rejected).

calibration.note: Sonnet aces all 30 interacting requirements monolithically (6 turns, $0.29). No headroom at N=30. CONFIRMS: intricacy of a complete spec is NOT a difficulty lever — only SCALE is (IFScale: frontier models hold ~97% to N~100, drop to ~62-68% at N=500). Keep as a low-N / overhead-regime point in the size sweep; real headroom requires a high-N (150-500 requirement) generator.
